notes: Tier 1 (Docker, headless). Mermaid is embedded in the published markdown, so exports are post-processed by tools/structurizr-mermaid-clean.py: Structurizr emits HTML <div> labels that GitHub renders as literal text, hardcoded white fills and a #444444/#cccccc palette that breaks in one theme or the other, no element border style (so a `border dashed` is lost), and every relationship as a dotted arrow (so a dashed relationship style means nothing). The script fixes all five; --dash-stroke and --dash-edge put the Proposed/shipping distinction back. tools/build-diagrams.sh runs the whole chain (validate, inspect, export, clean, render SVG with htmlLabels off) and fails if a <div> reaches the SVG. Verified 2026-09-01 by rendering with htmlLabels disabled.
workspaceScope: unscoped landscape (several systems in one workspace, decided deliberately; see the report)
